title: Russian Drone Strike Kills Two in Zaporizhzhia Gardening Community
detail: A Russian drone struck a gardening community in the Zaporizhzhia district on August 17, killing a 43-year-old man and a 41-year-old woman and sparking a fire, according to Ivan Fedorov, head of the Zaporizhzhia Regional Military Administration. A separate drone struck a vehicle carrying bread to the nearby village of Bilenke, also in Zaporizhzhia district. The strikes were part of a broader wave of 1,158 Russian attacks on 59 settlements across Zaporizhzhia region over the preceding 24 hours, which killed two and injured four.

title: Ukrainian Rocket Strike on Belgorod's Koloskovo Village Kills Six
detail: Ukrainian forces struck the village of Koloskovo in Belgorod region's Valuysky district — about 24km from the Ukrainian border — with rockets on August 17, killing at least six people and wounding four others, including a 14-year-old, according to acting Belgorod Governor Alexander Shuvaev. A structure was burned and a vehicle damaged. In a separate incident the same day, a Ukrainian drone strike killed one woman at an industrial facility in Russia's Astrakhan region.
